query DailyProtocolFeesBatch { analytics { d0: fees(startDate: "2026-10-16T00:00:00Z", endDate: "2026-10-16T23:59:59Z") { 
  fromDate
  toDate
  dailyFees
  dailyUserFees
  dailySupplySideRevenue
  dailyRevenue
  dailyProtocolRevenue
  dailyHoldersRevenue
  breakdown {
    borrowInterestAccrued
    borrowInterestAccruedForSupplySide
    borrowInterestAccruedForHolders
    borrowInterestAccruedForProtocol
    loanOriginationFees
    loanOriginationFeesForProtocol
    loanOriginationFeesForHolders
    liquidationBonus
  }
 } d1: fees(startDate: "2026-10-17T00:00:00Z", endDate: "2026-10-17T23:59:59Z") { 
  fromDate
  toDate
  dailyFees
  dailyUserFees
  dailySupplySideRevenue
  dailyRevenue

  dailyHoldersRevenue
  breakdown {
    borrowInterestAccrued
    borrowInterestAccruedForSupplySide
    borrowInterestAccruedForHolders
    borrowInterestAccruedForProtocol
    loanOriginationFees

  }
 } } }
